review_notes: I read the whole file. I also checked how hasseContent and hasseExp are defined in Definitions/Def_ModularCurve_MultCoveringFamily.lean. The only new definition in the file is IsContent. It says that n is the least p-adic valuation among the nonzero coefficients of zeroSeries. This is a specific characterisation of the minimum p-adic valuation of a Laurent series' coefficients, used to make hasseContent (a choice-based definition) usable. I found no Mathlib concept that matches it. Polynomial.content is a gcd and does not use padicValRat. HahnSeries.order is the lowest exponent, not a valuation of the coefficients. The file's other declarations are lemmas, so they are outside this rubric. I found no competing structure or definition to flag, and I have only mild uncertainty about whether Mathlib has an unnoticed Gauss-norm-style API for LaurentSeries.
